skill_contract.semantic_judge_policy: Judge the commissioned result, source fidelity, authority and handoff. Binding content follows adopted decisions and applicable authority; material known context stays recoverable with its actual status, and candidate routes remain optional. Fail material losses, invented authority, unresolved final contracts, product substitution, broken handoffs or unnecessary burdens that change scope, constrain execution or obstruct the result. Accept faithful wording, reasonable decomposition, sufficient preservation locations and viable delegated routes. Formatting, file totals, reference reads and dialogue length are not general outcome criteria. Return INCONCLUSIVE when decisive evidence is missing. Packet fields: turns[].executor_final.response contains user-visible answers; workspace_directories records directories; runtime_context records companion-Skill availability and observed loading.
